name: The Shattered Hand
summary: In Orgrimmar, Therzok tests rogues who seek a place in the Shattered Hand. He wants Tazan's recovered satchel opened with a key taken from an unwitting accomplice.

sections.title: A Test of Subtlety
sections.body: You have Tazan's locked satchel, but it is no use without its key. Therzok expects a rogue to master the lock through skill, not brute force. So he sends you to Gamon, a tauren drunkard who frequents Orgrimmar's tavern. Gamon is easily distracted, and he once helped Tazan. That makes him a fitting mark for quiet theft.

sections.title: Welcome to the Shadows
sections.body: Take the key from Gamon without alerting the tavern. Then open the satchel and bring Tazan's logbook to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow. A clean job meets the Shattered Hand's standards. Therzok gives you formal recognition as one of its operatives.

faq.q: Who is Gamon and why does he have the key?
faq.answer: Gamon once assisted Tazan, the operative Therzok is investigating. While carrying the satchel, Tazan left its key with Gamon, an unsuspecting drunkard who spends his days drinking in Orgrimmar's central tavern.
Tazan's logbook lies inside the locked satchel. It holds intelligence of interest to Therzok and the Shattered Hand. Recovering it tests your ability to secure vital information covertly.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand began as an infamous orcish clan from Draenor, known for self-mutilation and ruthlessness. In Orgrimmar, it is the Horde's guild of assassins, spies, and rogues, working from the subterranean Cleft of Shadow.
Therzok works from the Cleft of Shadow, a dim cavern network beneath Orgrimmar's rocky ridges. Warlocks, rogues, and shadowcraft gather there, away from daylight.

faq.q: Why doesn't Therzok just break open the satchel?
faq.answer: The satchel has a complex lock, and Therzok is testing a rogue's discipline. The Shattered Hand prizes precise theft and finesse over noisy destruction.
Handing over Tazan's logbook completes your initiation. Therzok recognizes you as a member of the Shattered Hand and gives you tools for covert work.

angles.text: As a rogue, you learn to stalk an unaware target in a crowded place, take a key unnoticed, and secure vital intelligence.
Beneath the martial honor of Thrall's new Horde, covert reconnaissance remains necessary. The Shattered Hand handles it quietly from deep within Orgrimmar.
